_doc: PR4 prop clusters (tools/props/clusters.py, docs/prop-clusters.md): members' pos [x, y, z] and yaw (degrees) relative to the cluster origin; 'asset' places the whole cluster as one prop (models + colliders + cover), null = place the members one by one.

clusters.name: Supply stack
clusters.purpose: Crates stacked two high against a wall or in the open: low and high cover.

clusters.name: Fuel point
clusters.purpose: Drums, jerrycans and gas bottles by a vehicle stand: low cover (and a reason not to shoot near it).

clusters.name: Generator corner
clusters.purpose: Generator, fuel, toolbox and a work light: the compound's power point.

clusters.name: Tyre and scrap pile
clusters.purpose: Tyres, rims, a burnt drum and cans: low cover, a hiding place in the open.

clusters.name: Rocks with quiver tree
clusters.purpose: Boulders, a quiver tree and succulents: hard cover and a landmark.

clusters.name: Rocks and deadwood
clusters.purpose: A boulder pile with a dead quiver trunk and branches: low and high cover.

clusters.name: Sandbag position (prefab)
clusters.purpose: Curved sandbag wall with ammunition and a jerrycan behind it.

clusters.name: Guard post (prefab)
clusters.purpose: The steel guard tower with a supply stack and a work light at its foot.

clusters.name: Pipe rack
clusters.purpose: The industrial pipe set with tools at its foot: high cover between containers.

clusters.name: Camera pole
clusters.purpose: An electricity pole with a security camera and a utility box: a landmark and a sightline hint.

clusters.name: Tool carts
clusters.purpose: Tool cart, tool chest, welding cart and hand truck: low and medium cover.

clusters.name: Barrel stack
clusters.purpose: Drums two deep with a plastic tote: low cover.

clusters.name: Workshop corner
clusters.purpose: Drill presses, a compressor and a storage cart: medium cover in a shed or under a lamp.

clusters.name: Cable drums (prefab)
clusters.purpose: Cable reels with barrels and a tote.

clusters.name: Cafe terrace
clusters.purpose: Two table-and-chair sets, a chalkboard and a planter on the pavement.

clusters.name: Market stall
clusters.purpose: A painted table with baskets and crates: low cover in a square.

clusters.name: Doorstep clutter
clusters.purpose: Bin, bags, a crate, a watering can and a plant by a door.

clusters.name: Bench corner
clusters.purpose: Bench, street lamp, bin and hydrant at a street corner.

clusters.name: Roadblock
clusters.purpose: Concrete barriers, drums and a covered car across a street: hard and low cover.

clusters.name: Rubble (prefab)
clusters.purpose: Brick rubble with a tyre and a barrier: low cover in a shelled street.

clusters.name: Cart with sacks (prefab)
clusters.purpose: The farm cart with sacks and a barrel beside it.

clusters.name: Supply dump (large)
clusters.purpose: Crate stacks two and three high, sacks and loose boxes round a hand truck: standing cover behind the stacks, crouch cover behind the rows.

clusters.name: Fuel dump (large)
clusters.purpose: Three rows of drums behind a barrier bund, jerrycan rows, a fuel pump and gas bottles: crouch cover along the drums, standing cover at the pump.

clusters.name: Motor-pool corner (large)
clusters.purpose: Tyre stacks, a tool cart and chests, a generator and compressor, oil drums and a work table: crouch cover at the tyre stacks, standing cover at the compressor.

clusters.name: Guard point (large)
clusters.purpose: An L of concrete barriers with crate seats, a radio, water cans and a lantern: standing cover along the L.

clusters.name: Pipe yard (large)
clusters.purpose: Two steel racks with pyramids of pipe in front, loose pipe runs, the pipe manifold, crates and drums: standing cover behind the racks.

clusters.name: Workshop bay (large)
clusters.purpose: Steel shelving along the back, a compressor, welding cart, drill presses, a tool cart with a vice, storage cart and bins: standing cover at the shelving and compressor.

clusters.name: Loading area (large)
clusters.purpose: Crate and tote stacks three high, hand trucks, a barrier line, a floodlight and loose boxes: standing cover behind the stacks, crouch cover at the barriers.

clusters.name: Market row (large)
clusters.purpose: Four stalls of tables with baskets, pots and crates, barrels and a chalkboard: crouch cover behind the tables and crates. (No awning model exists yet.)

clusters.name: Cafe terrace (large)
clusters.purpose: Four table-and-chair sets and two round tables, chairs knocked over, planters along the kerb, a signboard: crouch cover behind the planters, little else.

clusters.name: Street barricade (large)
clusters.purpose: A street-wide barricade of barriers, a tipped table, cabinet and sofa, drums, tyres and sandbag-like cement sacks: standing and crouch cover along its length.
